children: La Beaute Inc., a California-based medical aesthetics company, filed an S-1 to go public. The company plans to list on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the ticker LABI with a fixed offering price of $5.00 per share. The filing covers 10,000,000 shares, with the company cautioning there is no prior public market for its stock.

La Beaute operates a one-stop premium medical aesthetics platform that combines clinical treatments, medical-grade skincare, post-procedure repair products, and personalized membership services. The company plans to monetize through fee-for-service clinical care, product sales, and recurring membership subscriptions. Its strategy emphasizes client-centric service design, regulatory compliance, and expansion across Asia and global markets via clinics, partner outlets, and distribution channels. La Beaute positions itself on integrated care and ongoing client engagement to drive retention and brand loyalty.
: The global medical aesthetics and premium skincare markets are large and highly competitive.
: Demand is influenced by evolving consumer preferences and adoption of clinical treatments and medical-grade skincare.
: La Beaute aims to build a one-stop platform integrating clinical services, skincare, post-procedure products, and memberships.
: Established medical aesthetic clinic chains and premium skincare brands with greater resources.
: Growing interest in minimally invasive treatments, data privacy and compliance focus, and omni-channel client engagement.
: Not disclosed; early-stage with planned client-centric membership model
: Office at 7950 NW 53rd St, Ste 337, Miami, FL 33166 (no owned or rented properties stated)
: Plans to expand across Asia and global markets via clinics, partners, and e-commerce
: Intends to work with regional and international partners, medical professionals, and suppliers
: Transfer agent not yet appointed; one shareholder of record pre-offering

, Chief Executive Officer, Chairman, Director - Over 20 years in finance, accounting, and strategic investment; prior roles at Deloitte and a large multinational listed company; former lawyer and accountant.
, Director - 10 years of consulting experience in healthcare and medical aesthetics focusing on strategy, operations, and market-compliance advisory.
, Director - 5+ years in medical aesthetics across product operations, channel development, brand building, and compliance; experience with full-process operational management.
: Strategic acquisitions and investments, marketing, global expansion, and general working capital
